data.description: Once per day, a gryph can implant eggs into a helpless target or a target it is grappling.  As a full-round action, the gryph extends an ovipositor from its abdomen and penetrates the victim's flesh by making a successful sting attack (+5 melee).  On a hit, the ovipositor deals 1 point of damage and implants 1d4 eggs in the victim.  The eggs draw nutrients from the target's flesh, and give the target the sickened condition.  The eggs grow swiftly, hatching in a mere 1d4 minutes into ravenous gryph chicks that immediately burrow out of the victim's body.  This deals 2 points of Constitution damage per gryph chick, after which the hatchlings immediately take wing and fly away (if needed, use game statistics for a bat familiar to represent a hatchling).  Removing implanted eggs requires a DC 20 Heal check (a full-round action); each attempt deals 1 hit point of damage.  Although immunity to disease offers no special protection against gryph egg implantation, remove disease, heal, or similar effects destroy any implanted gryph eggs.
data.name: Implant Eggs
